Overview

New Rochelle is a city in NY with a population of 80,000. Westchester County city on Long Island Sound with a historic downtown and NYC commute. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
